skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.specializations: Type of acrobatics used, form or style — diving, trapeze, tumbling.
skills.summary: Characters with this skill can tumble, leap, and roll to avoid falling damage, to entertain an audience, or to surprise an opponent in combat.

skills.name: Aquatic Vehicle Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 4D in aquatic vehicle repair, and allows the design of various aquatic vehicles and aquatic vehicle systems.

skills.name: Aquatic Vehicle Operation
skills.specializations: Particular ship type or class — Oceanic transport, coastal runabout, skiff, sailboat.
skills.summary: This skill allows characters to pilot naval ships and boats.

skills.name: Aquatic Vehicle Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then one day, then two days. May be customized to circumstances.
skills.specializations: Particular ship type or class — Oceanic transport, coastal runabout, skiff. sailboat.
skills.summary: This skill represents a character’s familiarity with the workings of aquatic vehicles, and his ability to repair and modify them.

skills.name: Archaic Guns
skills.specializations: Indicates a specific kind or model of archaic gun — black powder pistol, matchlock, musket, wheelock.
skills.summary: Archaic guns is a “ranged combat” skill used to fire any primitive gun, including black powder pistols, flintlocks and muskets.

skills.name: Archaic Starship Piloting
skills.specializations: Particular ship type or class — Delaya-class, Coruscant-class heavy courier.
skills.summary: This skill allows characters to pilot primitive starships and other basic archaic ship designs.

skills.name: Armor Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 4D in armor repair. Allows the design of various types of personal armor

skills.name: Armor Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then two hours. May be customized to circumstances.
skills.specializations: Armor Type — Stormtrooper armor.
skills.summary: Armor repair reflects the character’s ability to fix and modify armor that has been damaged.

skills.name: Alien Species
skills.specializations: Knowledge of a particular alien species — Wookiees, Gamorreans, Ewoks, Sullustans.
skills.summary: Alien species involves knowledge of any species outside of the character’s.

skills.name: Artillery
skills.specializations: The particular type or model of projectile artillery — cannons, Golan Arms M102 Fire Arc.
skills.summary: Artillery is the “ranged combat” skill used to fire all non-energy projectile weapons, such as cannons and field guns (excluding self-propelled projectiles or launched grenades, which are covered under missile weapons).

skills.name: Astrogation
skills.time_taken: One minute when your position is known and you are following a commonly-traveled jump route for which hyperspace coordinates have already been calculated (can be reduced to one round in emergencies). A few hours when your position is known, but your destination is one to which you have not traveled before and the nav computer must calculate coordinates. One day when you must take readings to determine your ship’s current position and then compute jump coordinates.
skills.specializations: Specific trade route — Kessel Run, Tatooine to Coruscant, Corellian Run Trade Route.
skills.summary: Starship pilots use astrogation to plot a course from one star system to another.

skills.name: Bargain
skills.specializations: Kind of merchandise to be purchased or sold — spice, weapons, droids, datapads.
skills.summary: Characters use this skill to haggle over prices for goods they want to purchase or sell.

skills.name: Beast Riding
skills.specializations: Particular riding animal — banthas, Cracian thumpers, dewbacks, tauntauns.
skills.summary: Beast riding represents a character’s ability to ride any live mount.

skills.name: Blaster
skills.specializations: A specific type or model of character-scale blaster weapon — blaster pistol, heavy blaster pistol, blaster rifle, BlasTech DL-44, hold-out blaster.
skills.summary: Blaster is the “ranged combat” skill used to shoot blaster weapons that can be held and carried by a character.

skills.name: Blaster Artillery
skills.specializations: The particular type or model of artillery — anti-infantry, anti-vehicle, Golan Arms DF.9, surface-to-space, surface-to-surface.
skills.summary: Blaster artillery is the “ranged combat” skill that covers all fixed, multi-crew heavy energy weapons, such as those used by the Rebel Alliance at the Battle of Hoth and the fixed ion cannons fired from a planet’s surface.

skills.name: Blaster Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then two hours. May be customized to circumstances.
skills.specializations: Type or model blaster — blaster pistols, surface-to-surface blaster artillery, heavy blaster cannon.
skills.summary: A character’s ability to fix and modify blaster weapons (character-, speeder- and walker-scale) is represented by his blaster repair skill.

skills.name: Bowcaster
skills.summary: Bowcaster is a “ranged combat” skill that reflects the user’s proficiency at firing the unusual Wookiee bowcaster.

skills.name: Bows
skills.specializations: Specific type or model bow — crossbow, long bow, short bow.
skills.summary: Bows is a “ranged combat” skill covering all bow-type weapons, including short bows, long bows and crossbows (excluding Wookiee bowcasters, which fall under the bowcaster skill).

skills.name: Brawling
skills.specializations: Specific brawling style — boxing, martial arts.
skills.summary: Brawling is the “melee combat” skill used for fighting hand-to-hand without any weapons.

skills.name: Brawling Parry
skills.specializations: Style of brawling being parried when unarmed and avoiding a brawling or melee attack — boxing, martial arts.
skills.summary: Brawling parry is a “reaction skill” used to avoid being hit by a brawling or melee combat attack if you’re unarmed.

skills.name: Bureaucracy
skills.specializations: Specific planetary or administrative government, or branch within it — Tatooine, Celanon, Bureau of Commerce, Bureau of Ships and Services.
skills.summary: This skill reflects a character’s familiarity with bureaucracies and their procedures.

skills.name: Business
skills.time_taken: One round to one day or longer.
skills.specializations: Field or organization (company, conglomerate, trade guild) — starships, weapons, droids, Sienar Fleet Systems, Corporate Sector Authority, Golan Arms.
skills.summary: The character has a working knowledge of businesses and business procedures.

skills.name: Capital Ship Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 5D in capital ship repair, 4D capital ship weapon repair, and 2D computer programming/repair. It is possible to take this skill without the required die codes in capital ship weapon repair and computer programming/repair, but the bonus effects from engineering would not apply to those areas. This skill allows the design of various capital ships, and capital ship systems.

skills.name: Capital Ship Gunnery
skills.specializations: Weapon type or model — concussion missiles, gravity well projectors, ion cannons, laser cannons, proton torpedoes, tractor beams, turbolasers.
skills.summary: Capital ship gunnery is the “ranged combat” skill that covers the operation of capital-scale starship weapons, including turbolasers, ion cannons and tractor beams.

skills.name: Capital Ship Piloting
skills.specializations: Type or class of capital ship — Imperial Star Destroyer, Victory Star Destroyer, Nebulon-B frigate, Trade Federation Battleship.
skills.summary: Capital ship piloting covers the operation of large combat starships such as Imperial Star Destroyers, Carrack-class cruisers, Corellian Corvettes and Mon Cal cruisers.

skills.name: Capital Ship Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then one day, then two days. May be customized to circumstances.
skills.specializations: Type or class of capital ship — Imperial Star Destroyer, Victory Star Destroyer, Nebulon-B frigate.
skills.summary: This skill represents a character’s familiarity with the workings of capital ships, and his ability to repair them.

skills.name: Capital Ship Shields
skills.summary: Characters use this skill when operating shields on capital-scale starships, both military and civilian.

skills.name: Capital Ship Weapon Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then one day, then two days. May be customized to circumstances.
skills.specializations: Weapon type or model — concussion missiles, gravity well projectors, ion cannons, laser cannon, proton torpedoes, tractor beams, turbolaser.
skills.summary: Capital ship weapon repair is used to repair capital -scale ship weapons.

skills.name: Civil/Industrial Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 1D in bureaucracy, 2D business, 3D demolitions, 1D law enforcement, and 2D in any two repair skills. This is a skill that relates to the building, maintenance, and modification of settlements, civic projects, businesses, and factories.

skills.name: Climbing/Jumping
skills.specializations: Climbing, jumping.
skills.summary: Use this skill when a character attempts to climb a tree, wall or cliff, leap a wide gap, or jump up and grab an outcropping.

skills.name: Command
skills.specializations: Leader’s unit — Rogue Squadron, Imperial stormtroopers.
skills.summary: Command is a measure of a character’s ability to convince gamemaster characters and subordinates to do what they’re told.

skills.name: Communications
skills.specializations: Type or model of communications unit — comlink, subspace radio.
skills.summary: Communications represents a character’s ability to use subspace radios, comlinks and other communications systems.

skills.name: Computer Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 5D in computer programming/repair. This skill allows the design and construction of various computers, computer software, and complex computer networks.

skills.name: Computer Programming/Repair
skills.time_taken: One round to several minutes, hours or days.
skills.specializations: Type or model computer — portable computer, mainframe, datapad, YT1300- computer.
skills.summary: Characters use this skill to repair, modify, and program computers — it also covers a character’s familiarity with computer security procedures, his ability to evade them, and the ability to get secure information.

skills.name: Con
skills.time_taken: One combat round to several minutes, depending upon how long it takes the character to say what is needed to pull off the con.
skills.specializations: Particular method of conning — disguise, fast-talk.
skills.summary: Con is used to trick and deceive characters, or otherwise convince them to do something that isn’t in their best interest.

skills.name: Cultures
skills.time_taken: One round to one day or longer.
skills.specializations: Planet or social group — Corellians, Alderaan royal family, Brentaal, Prexian pirates.
skills.summary: This skill reflects knowledge of particular cultures and common cultural forms (primitive tribal civilizations tend to be somewhat similar, for example).

skills.name: Demolitions
skills.specializations: Specific target type — bridges, walls, vehicles.
skills.summary: Demolitions reflects a character’s ability to set explosives for both destructive purposes and to accomplish specific special effects.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.specializations: Kind of ranged attack to be dodged — energy weapons, grenades, missile weapons.
skills.summary: Dodge is a “reaction skill” used to avoid any ranged attack, including blaster fire, grenades, bullets and arrows.

skills.name: Droid Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires Requires 5D in droid repair or 5D in droid programming. This skill allows the design and construction of droids, See the “Droids” chapter for rules pertaining to the use of this skill.

skills.name: Droid Programming
skills.time_taken: 15 minutes to several hours or days.
skills.specializations: Type or model droid — astromech droid, protocol droid, probe droid.
skills.summary: Characters may use this skill to program a droid to learn a new skill or task.

skills.name: Droid Repair
skills.time_taken: 15 minutes, then one hour, then two hours; may be several hours or days depending upon the level of repair.
skills.specializations: Type or model droid — astromech droid, protocol droid, probe droid.
skills.summary: This skill represents a character’s talent to repair, modify, and maintain droids.

skills.name: Equipment Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 5D in equipment repair. This skill allows for the design and construction of various small equipment items and non-blaster weapons (e.g. vibroblades, breath masks, slugthrowers, comlinks).

skills.name: Equipment Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then two hours. May be customized to circumstances.
skills.specializations: Type or model equipment — breath mask, comlink, slugthrower, vibroblade.
skills.summary: A character’s ability to fix and modify various character-, speeder-, and walker-scale equipment items (including non-blaster, and non-energy beam weapons).

skills.name: Firearms
skills.specializations: Type or model firearm used — pistols, rifles, machineguns.
skills.summary: Firearms is the “ranged combat” skill used to for all guns which fire bullets, including pistols, rifles, machine guns, assault rifles and any other firearms.

skills.name: First Aid
skills.specializations: Species of patient — humans, Ewoks, Wookiees.
skills.summary: First aid reflects a character’s ability to perform emergency life saving procedures in the field.

skills.name: Flamethrower
skills.specializations: Type or model flamethrower — Merr- Sonn C-22, Wrist-Mounted Flame Projectors.
skills.summary: Flamethrower is the “ranged combat” skill used to fire all types of flame projectors, including flame rifles, wrist mounted flame projectors, and flame carbines.

skills.name: Forgery
skills.specializations: Specific kind of documentation to be forged — security codes, datapad scandocs, starship permits.
skills.summary: The character has the ability to falsify electronic documents to say what the character wishes.

skills.name: Gambling
skills.specializations: Particular game of chance — sabacc, Trin sticks, warp-top.
skills.summary: Gambling reflects a character’s skill at various games of chance — it is used to increase his odds of winning.

skills.name: Grenade
skills.specializations: Kind or model of grenade — thermal detonator, anti-vehicle grenade.
skills.summary: Grenade is the “ranged combat” skill to throw grenades.

skills.name: Ground Vehicle Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 4D in ground vehicle repair. This skill allows the design of various vehicles and vehicle systems.

skills.name: Ground Vehicle Operation
skills.specializations: Type or model ground vehicle — compact assault vehicle, Juggernaut.
skills.summary: Ground vehicle operation covers primitive wheeled and tracked land vehicles, including Jawa sandcrawlers, the Rebel personnel transports on Yavin IV, personal transportation cars and bikes, and cargo haulers.

skills.name: Ground Vehicle Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then one day, then two days. May be customized to circumstances.
skills.specializations: Type or model ground vehicle — compact assault vehicle, Juggernaut.
skills.summary: This skill represents a character’s familiarity with the workings of ground vehicles, and his ability to modify or repair them.

skills.name: Hide
skills.specializations: Camouflage.
skills.summary: Hide represents a character’s ability to conceal objects from view.

skills.name: Hover Vehicle Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 4D in hover vehicle repair. This skill allows the design of various hover vehicles and hover vehicle systems.

skills.name: Hover Vehicle Operation
skills.specializations: Type or model vehicle — hoverscout.
skills.summary: Hover vehicles generate a cushion of air for travel — hover vehicle operation enables characters to pilot these

skills.name: Hover Vehicle Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then one day, then two days. May be customized to circumstances.
skills.specializations: Type or model hover vehicle — hoverscout.
skills.summary: Characters use this skill when repairing or modifying hover vehicle systems.

skills.name: Installation Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 2D computer programming/repair, 2D demolitions, and 1D in any two of the following — (A) capital ship engineering, (A) civil/industrial engineering, (A) space transports engineering, (A) starfighter engineering, or (A) weapons engineering. This skill allows for the construction of fortified bases, strong holds, and other military installations.

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.time_taken: One round to several hours or longer.
skills.specializations: Interrogation, bullying.
skills.summary: Intimidation is a character’s ability to scare or frighten others to force them to obey commands, reveal information they wish to keep hidden, or otherwise do the bidding of the intimidating character.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.specializations: Locale or field of investigation — Mos Eisley, Imperial City, property estates, criminal records.
skills.summary: Investigation is a character’s ability to find and gather information regarding someone else’s activities, and then draw a conclusion about what the target has done or where she has gone.

skills.name: Jet Pack Operation
skills.summary: This skill represents a character’s skill at using jet packs.

skills.name: Languages
skills.specializations: Specific language known — Wookiee, Huttese, Bocce, Ewok.
skills.summary: The common language of the Known Galaxy is Basic.

skills.name: Law Enforcement
skills.specializations: Particular planet’s or organization’s laws and procedures — Alderaan, Tatooine, the Empire, Rebel Alliance.
skills.summary: The character is familiar with law enforcement techniques and procedures.

skills.name: Lifting
skills.summary: Lifting is a character’s ability to lift heavy objects; it’s also the character’s ability to carry something for a long time.

skills.name: Lightsaber
skills.specializations: Specific type or model lightsaber — double-bladed lightsaber, light-whip.
skills.summary: Lightsaber is the “melee combat” skill used for the lightsaber, the weapon of the famed Jedi Knights.

skills.name: Lightsaber Repair/Engineering
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then one day, then two days. Construction takes approximately one month.
skills.summary: Specific type or model lightsaber — double-bladed lightsaber, light-whip.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.specializations: Specific field known — medicines, cyborging, surgery.
skills.summary: Characters with this skill can perform complex medical procedures such as surgery, operation of bacta tanks, and the installation of cybernetic replacements and enhancements.
skills.prerequisites_text: Advanced skill — requires first aid of at least 5D.

skills.name: Melee Combat
skills.specializations: Specific type of melee weapon — swords, knives, axes, vibroblades, vibro-axes.
skills.summary: Melee combat is the “melee combat” skill used for all hand-to-hand weapons (except lightsabers, which is covered under the lightsaber skill).

skills.name: Melee Parry
skills.specializations: Type of melee weapon used — lightsabers, knives, clubs, axes, vibroblades.
skills.summary: Melee parry is the “reaction skill” used if a character has a melee weapon and is attacked by someone with a melee combat, brawling or lightsaber attack.

skills.name: Missile Weapons
skills.specializations: Type or model missile weapon — concussion missile, grenade launcher, Golan Arms FC1 flechette launcher, power harpoon.
skills.summary: Missile weapons is the “ranged combat” skill used to fire all types of missile weapons, including grappling hook launchers, grenade launchers, and personal proton torpedo launchers.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.specializations: Specific form of persuasion — debate, storytelling, flirt, oration.
skills.summary: Persuasion is similar to con and bargain — and is a little bit of both.

skills.name: Pick Pocket
skills.summary: Characters use pick pocket to pick the pockets of others, or to palm objects without being noticed.

skills.name: Planetary Systems
skills.specializations: Specific system or planet — Tatooine, Endor, Hoth, Kessel.
skills.summary: This skill reflects a character’s general knowledge of geography, weather, life-forms, trade products, settlements, technology, government and other general information about different systems and planets.

skills.name: Podracer Operation
skills.specializations: Particular custom pod racer.
skills.summary: Advanced Skill — requires repulsorlift operations of at least 5D.

skills.name: Powersuit Operation
skills.specializations: Particular kind or model powersuit — spacetrooper armor, servo-lifter.
skills.summary: Powersuits are devices which enhance a person’s natural abilities through servo-mechanisms and powered movement.

skills.name: Repulsorlift Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 4D in repulsorlift repair. This skill allows the design of various repulsorlift vehicles and repulsorlift vehicle systems.

skills.name: Repulsorlift Operation
skills.specializations: Type or model repulsorlift vehicle — XP-38 landspeeder, Incom T-16 Skyhopper, Rebel Alliance combat snowspeeder.
skills.summary: The character knows how to operate common repulsorlift (or “antigrav”) craft, including landspeeders, snowspeeders, T-16 skyhoppers, cloud cars, airspeeders, speeder bikes, skiffs and sail barges.

skills.name: Repulsorlift Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then one day, then two days. May be customized to circumstances.
skills.specializations: Type or model repulsorlift vehicle — XP-38 landspeeder, Incom T-16 Skyhopper, Rebel Alliance combat snowspeeder.
skills.summary: Repulsorlift repair represents a character’s affinity for repairing and modifying vehicles with repulsorlift generators.

skills.name: Rocket Pack Operation
skills.summary: This skill reflects the character’s ability to use personal, self-contained rocket packs.

skills.name: Running
skills.specializations: Long distance, short sprint.
skills.summary: Running is the character’s ability to run and keep his balance, especially in dangerous terrain.

skills.name: Scholar
skills.specializations: Particular field of study — archaeology, Jedi lore, history, geology, physics.
skills.summary: This skill reflects formal academic training or dedicated research in a particular field.

skills.name: Search
skills.specializations: Tracking.
skills.summary: This skill is used when the character is trying to spot hidden objects or individuals.

skills.name: Security
skills.specializations: Type or model security device — magna lock, blast door, retinal lock.
skills.summary: This skill represents a character’s knowledge of physical security systems: locks, alarm systems and other detection devices.

skills.name: Sensors
skills.specializations: Type or model scanner — hand scanner, med diagnostic scanner, heat sensor.
skills.summary: Characters with the this skill can operate various kinds of sensors, including those that detect lifeforms, identify vehicles, pick up energy readings, and make long-distance visual readings.

skills.name: Sneak
skills.specializations: Specific type of terrain — jungle, urban.
skills.summary: Sneak represents the character’s ability to move silently, hide from view, move in shadows and otherwise creep around without being noticed.

skills.name: Space Transports
skills.specializations: Type or model transport — YT-1300 transport, Gallofree medium transport, Corellian Action VI transport.
skills.summary: Space transports is used to pilot all space transports: any non-combat starship, ranging from small light freighters (the Millennium Falcon is a highly-modified YT- 1300 light freighter) and scout ships to passenger liners, huge container s

skills.name: Space Transport Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 5D in space transports repair. This skill allows the design of various space transports and space transport systems.

skills.name: Space Transports Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then one day, then two days. May be customized by circumstances.
skills.specializations: Type or model transport — YT-1300 transport, Gallofree medium transport, Corellian Action VI transport.
skills.summary: Characters with this skill can repair and modify space transports.

skills.name: Stamina
skills.time_taken: Stamina checks are made when characters exert themselves over long periods of time.
skills.summary: Stamina checks reflect that a character is being pushed to his or her physical limits.

skills.name: Starfighter Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 5D starfighter repair and 3D starship weapons repair. It is possible to take this skill without the required die code in starship weapons repair, but the bonus effects from engineering would only apply to non-weapon functions. This skill allows the design of various starfighters and starfighter systems.

skills.name: Starfighter Piloting
skills.specializations: Type or model starfighter — X-wing, TIE/In, TIE interceptor, Z-95 Headhunter.
skills.summary: Starfighter piloting is used for all combat starfighters, including X-wings, Y-wings, A-wings, and TIE fighters.

skills.name: Starfighter Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then one day, then two days. May be customized to circumstances.
skills.specializations: Type or model starfighter — X-wing, TIE/In, TIE interceptor, Z-95 Headhunter.
skills.summary: This repair skill represents a character’s ability to fix and modify starfighters.

skills.name: Starship Gunnery
skills.specializations: Specific type or model weapon — concussion missiles, ion cannons, laser cannon, proton torpedoes, turbolasers.
skills.summary: Starship gunnery is the “ranged combat” skill that covers all starfighter-scale weapons, including laser cannons, ion cannons, concussion missiles, and proton torpedoes.

skills.name: Starship Shields
skills.summary: Starship shields is the skill used to operate shields on all starfighter-scale ships.

skills.name: Starship Weapon Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then one day, then two days. May be customized to circumstances.
skills.specializations: Specific type or model weapon — concussion missiles, ion cannons, laser cannon, proton torpedoes, turbolasers.
skills.summary: Starship weapon repair covers a character’s ability to fix and modify starfighter-scale weapons.

skills.name: Streetwise
skills.time_taken: One round to one day or longer.
skills.specializations: Specific planet or criminal organization — Celanon, Corellia, Jabba the Halt’s organization, Black Sun, Talon Karrde’s organization.
skills.summary: Streetwise reflects a character’s familiarity with underworld organizations and their operation.

skills.name: Submersible Vehicle Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 4D in submersible vehicle repair. This skill allows the design of various submersible vehicles and submersible vehicle systems.

skills.name: Submersible Vehicle Operation
skills.specializations: Particular submersible type or class — Bongo, electric submarine.
skills.summary: This skill allows characters to pilot submersible ships and boats.

skills.name: Submersible Vehicle Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then one hour, then one day, then two days. May be customized to circumstances.
skills.specializations: Particular submersible type or class — Bongo, electric submarine.
skills.summary: This repair skill represents a character’s ability to fix and modify submersible vehicles.

skills.name: Survival
skills.time_taken: One round when used for knowledge or reacting to danger; one hour or more when looking for necessities.
skills.specializations: Type of environment — volcano, jungle, desert, poisonous atmosphere.
skills.summary: This skill represents how much a character knows about surviving in hostile environments, including deserts, jungles, ocean, forests, asteroid belts, volcanoes, poisonous atmosphere worlds, mountains and other dangerous terrain.

skills.name: Swimming
skills.time_taken: One round to several minutes or hours.
skills.summary: This skill represents the character’s ability to stay afloat in aquatic environments — lakes, oceans, flooding rivers and luxury starliner swimming pools.

skills.name: Swoop Operation
skills.specializations: Specific type or model swoop — TaggeCo Air-2, Ubrikkian Skybird.
skills.summary: Swoops are dangerously fast, difficult to pilot vehicles which combine a typical repulsorlift engine with an ion engine afterburner for unbelievable performance.

skills.name: Tactics
skills.specializations: Type of military unit — squads, fleets, capital ships, ground assault.
skills.summary: Tactics represents a character’s skill in deploying military forces and maneuvering them to his best advantage.

skills.name: Thrown Weapons
skills.specializations: Specific kind of thrown weapon — knife, spear, sling.
skills.summary: Thrown weapons is the “ranged combat” skill used whenever a character employs a primitive thrown weapon, including throwing knives, slings, throwing spears and javelins.

skills.name: Value
skills.specializations: Type of goods or specific planet’s markets — starships, droids, Kessel, Coruscant.
skills.summary: This skill reflects a character’s ability to gauge the fair market value of goods based on the local economy, the availability of merchandise, quality and other market factors.

skills.name: Vehicle Blasters
skills.specializations: Type or model of vehicle-mounted blaster — heavy blaster cannon, heavy laser cannon, light blaster cannon, light laser cannon, medium blaster cannon, medium laser cannon.
skills.summary: Vehicle blasters is the “ranged combat” skill used to fire vehicle-mounted energy weapons, especially those that are speeder- or walker-scale.

skills.name: Walker Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 4D in walker repair. This skill allows the design of various walkers and walker systems.

skills.name: Walker Operation
skills.specializations: Particular kind of walker — AT-AT, AT- ST, AT-PT.
skills.summary: Walkers are difficult vehicles to learn how to operate.

skills.name: Walker Repair
skills.time_taken: In general, 15 minutes, then six hours, then one day, then two days. May be customized to circumstances.
skills.specializations: Particular kind of walker — AT-AT, AT- ST, AT-PT.
skills.summary: Characters use this skill when repairing or modifying walker systems.

skills.name: Weapon Engineering
skills.prerequisites_text: Requires 5D in any two of the following — blaster repair, capital ship weapon repair, demolitions, equipment repair, starship weapon repair. This skill allows for the design and construction of various weapons systems and blasters.

skills.name: Willpower
skills.specializations: Kind of coercion to be resisted — persuasion, intimidation.
skills.summary: Willpower is a character’s strength of will and determination.

force_powers.name: Absorb/Dissipate Energy
force_powers.control_difficulty: Very Easy for sunburn and other very minor energy sources; Easy for intense sun; Moderate for solar wind and other modest energy sources (blaster bolts and Force lightening); Difficult for radiation storms and other intense energy sources (speeder-scale damage).
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows the Jedi to absorb or dissipate energy, including light, heat, radiation and blaster bolts.

force_powers.name: Accelerate Healing
force_powers.control_difficulty: Easy for wounded characters, Moderate for incapacitated characters, Difficult for mortally wounded characters.
force_powers.effect_summary: A Jedi who uses this power successfully may make two natural healing rolls for the current day (12 hours apart) regardless of the severity of the injury.

force_powers.name: Burst of Speed
force_powers.effect_summary: A Jedi can use this power to enhance his Move rating, increasing his running and walking speeds dramatically for a short period of time.

force_powers.name: Concentration
force_powers.control_difficulty: Easy if the Jedi is relaxed and at peace; Difficult if the Jedi is filled with aggression, fear or other negative emotions; Very Difficult if the Jedi is acting on those negative emotions.
force_powers.effect_summary: When using this power, the Jedi clears all negative thoughts from her mind, feeling the Force flowing through the universe and her own being.

force_powers.name: Contort/Escape
force_powers.control_difficulty: Very Easy for loose bonds; Easy for hand binder; Moderate for serious restraints; Difficult to Heroic for maximum security (varies at gamemaster’s discretion, depending on security measures).
force_powers.effect_summary: The character may escape bonds by contorting in painful and difficult (but still physically possible) ways.

force_powers.name: Control Disease
force_powers.control_difficulty: Very Easy for a mild infection, such as a cold; Easy for a modest infection or illness, such as a high fever or severe flu; Moderate for a severe illness, such as gangrene or a hive virus; Difficult for a life-threatening disease; Very Difficult for a massive, long-standing disease; Heroic for a rapid-acting life-threatening disease.
force_powers.time_to_use: 30 minutes to several uses over the course of weeks.
force_powers.effect_summary: Control disease allows the Jedi to direct and control the anti-bodies and healing resources of her body to throw off an infection or to resist diseases within the body.

force_powers.name: Control Pain
force_powers.control_difficulty: Very Easy for wounded or stunned characters, Easy for incapacitated characters, Difficult for mortally wounded characters.
force_powers.effect_summary: A wounded Jedi who controls pain can act as if she has not been wounded, starting with the round after the power roll has been made.

force_powers.name: Detoxify Poison
force_powers.control_difficulty: Very Easy for a very mild poison, such as alcohol; Easy for a mild poison; Moderate for an average poison; Difficult for a virulent poison; Very Difficult to Heroic for a neurotoxin.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows a Jedi to detoxify or eject poisons that have entered her body.

force_powers.name: Emptiness
force_powers.note: Characters who are consumed by the dark side of the Force may not use this power.
force_powers.effect_summary: The user empties her mind and allows the Force to flow through her.

force_powers.name: Enhance Attribute
force_powers.effect_summary: A Jedi uses this power to increase a single attribute for a limited period.

force_powers.name: Force of Will
force_powers.note: Force of will does not protect against Force lightning or Force storms or objects hurled by telekinesis since in each case the power creates a distinct physical manifestation. These are external rather than internal powers, in which case willpower would have no bearing on resistance. Force of will works on injure/kill, telekinetic kill, inflict pain, and other powers which directly use the Force to affect the target.
force_powers.effect_summary: By using force of will, the character uses his or her own willpower skill to fight the effects of hostile Force powers.

force_powers.name: Hibernation Trance
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows a Jedi to place herself into a deep trance, remarkably slowing all body functions.

force_powers.name: Instinctive Astrogation Control
force_powers.control_difficulty: Very Difficult. Modified by astrogation difficulty.
force_powers.effect_summary: Instinctive astrogation control is far more difficult than the standard sense-based instinctive astrogation power because rather than trying to feel the correct solutions to the hyperspace equations, the Jedi calculates them in his head.

force_powers.name: Rage
force_powers.warning: A Jedi who uses this gains one Dark Side Point.
force_powers.note: This power can only be used by characters who have been consumed by the dark side of the Force.
force_powers.effect_summary: Rage allows a character to feel the influence of the dark side.

force_powers.name: Reduce Injury
force_powers.control_difficulty: Moderate for incapacitated characters, Difficult for mortally wounded characters, Very Difficult for dead characters.
force_powers.note: It is not always a “selfish” act to save one’s life, so the character might be able to get the Force Point back. If the character was fighting to save her friends from certain doom — and if she fails, they certainly die — then this could even be considered an heroic action.
force_powers.effect_summary: A Jedi may use this power to reduce the amount of injury she suffers.

force_powers.name: Remain Conscious
force_powers.control_difficulty: Easy for stunned characters, Moderate for incapacitated characters, Difficult for mortally wounded characters.
force_powers.effect_summary: Remain conscious allows a Jedi to remain conscious even after suffering injuries which would knock her unconscious.

force_powers.name: Remove Fatigue
force_powers.effect_summary: The character uses this power to combat the effects of strenuous work.

force_powers.name: Resist Stun
force_powers.effect_summary: Resist stun allows the Jedi to prepare her body to resist the effects of stun damage.

force_powers.name: Short-Term Memory Enhancement
force_powers.effect_summary: When a Jedi uses this power, he or she can replay recent events in order to more carefully examine images and peripheral occurrences.

force_powers.name: Up the Walls
force_powers.effect_summary: You can use some or all of your movement on a wall, as long as you begin and end your turn on the floor.

force_powers.name: Beast Languages
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Easy if the animal is domesticated/ friendly (such as a bantha); Moderate to Difficult if the animal is wild, but non-predatory (such as an undomesticated tauntaun); Very Difficult to Heroic if the animal is ferocious/predatory (such as a wild rancor).
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows the Jedi to translate a beast-language and allows the Jedi to speak it.

force_powers.name: Combat Sense
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Moderate for one opponent, +3 for each additional opponent the Jedi wishes to defend against.
force_powers.effect_summary: Combat sense allows a Jedi to focus on the battle at hand.

force_powers.name: Danger Sense
force_powers.effect_summary: Danger sense allows a Jedi to extend his senses around himself like protective sensors creating an early warning system for as long as the power remains in effect.

force_powers.name: Direction Sense
force_powers.effect_summary: Direction sense allows a Jedi to be guided by the Force toward a particular goal or destination.

force_powers.name: Instinctive Astrogation
force_powers.effect_summary: This is the more well known ability of the Jedi to calculate astrogation routes without the use of a nav computer.

force_powers.name: Life Detection
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Very Easy if the subject has Force skills or is Force-sensitive; Moderate if not. Modified by relationship.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows Jedi to detect live sentient beings who might otherwise remain hidden.

force_powers.name: Life Sense
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Very Easy. Modified by proximity and relationship.
force_powers.effect_summary: The user can sense the presence and identity of a specific person for whom she searches.

force_powers.name: Life Web
force_powers.note: The Force-user must choose one specific species as a specialization (see below).
force_powers.effect_summary: This power is used to detect large concentrations of members of a specific species such as humans, Rodians, or Chadra-Fan.

force_powers.name: Magnify Senses
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows a Jedi to increase the effectiveness of her normal senses to perceive things that otherwise would be impossible without artificial aids.

force_powers.name: Merge Senses
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows a Force user to perceive things through the senses of another creature, one with animal intelligence or less.

force_powers.name: Postcognition
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Easy if seeing less than two hours into the past; Moderate for seeing more than two hours but less than a week into the past; Difficult for seeing more than a week but less than six months into the past; Very Difficult for seeing more than six months but less than a year into the past; Heroic for seeing more than a year but less than two years into the past; +10 for each additional year.
force_powers.time_to_use: Five minutes; the time to use may be reduced by adding +10 for each minute cut. Minimum time to use of one minute.
force_powers.effect_summary: Postcognition allows a Jedi to investigate the tenuous imprints of the Force left on objects when they are handled by living beings.

force_powers.name: Predict Natural Disaster
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Easy if the Jedi has lived in the area for more than a year. Moderate if the Jedi has been living within the area between six and 12 months. Difficult if the Jedi has been living within the area between one and six months. Very Difficult if the Jedi has been living within the area less than one month. Modified by severity of disaster (larger disasters are easier to predict) and degree to which the disaster could reasonably be predicted (gamemasters may decide that disasters are easier or harder to predict based on a multitude of factors).
force_powers.time_to_use: 15 minutes. May be reduced in five-minute increments by increasing difficulty one level per five-minute increment (minimum time to use is one minute).
force_powers.effect_summary: The Jedi can sense local meteorological and geological conditions and predict imminent disasters, such as earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, floods, landslides, avalanches, cave-ins, tornadoes, hurricanes (hurricanes can also can be predicted with weather sense)

force_powers.name: Receptive Telepathy
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Very Easy for friendly, non-resisting targets. A resisting target makes a Perception or control roll to determine the difficulty. Modified by proximity and relationship.
force_powers.effect_summary: A Jedi who makes the power roll can read the surface thoughts and emotions of the target.

force_powers.name: Sense Force
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Moderate for an area; Difficult for sensing details or specific objects within the area. Modified by proximity.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power is used to sense the ambient Force within a place.

force_powers.name: Sense Force Potential
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Moderate for friendly, unresistant targets. Moderate plus target’s Perception or control roll (whichever is higher) to determine the difficulty of the probe on an unwilling subject.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows a Jedi to probe the mind of a target, and determine whether that person has the potential to be strong in the Force.

force_powers.name: Sense Path
force_powers.effect_summary: This power informs a character of the “path” he travels: whether his current actions are likely to lead him to the dark side, and whether any specified future actions are likely to do so (this power may be thought of as farseeing without control).

force_powers.name: Shift Sense
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Moderate for simple phenomena (such as heat or simple scents); Difficult for more uncommon phenomena (such as comm frequencies, infrared radiation); Very Difficult for specific, complex phenomena (such as setting olfactory nerves to detect the presence of Tibanna gas).
force_powers.effect_summary: The character may shift his or her senses as to detect phenomena of a different type than normal.

force_powers.name: Translation
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Moderate for humans or aliens. Difficult for droids. If the target is being purposely cryptic add +5 to the difficulty, +20 if the language is written down.
force_powers.effect_summary: The character may translate a language and speak it.

force_powers.name: Weather Sense
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Easy if the Jedi has lived in the area for more than a year; Moderate if the Jedi has lived in the area between six and twelve months; Difficult if the Jedi has lived in the area between one and six months; Very Difficult if the Jedi has lived in the area less than one month. Modified for proximity and local meteorological conditions.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows the Jedi to attune himself to the workings of local weather patterns.

force_powers.name: Force Push
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Target’s control or Strength roll, +3 to difficulty for every 5 meters away from target, line of sight only.
force_powers.effect_summary: With this power, a Jedi may use the Force to push several adjacent targets backwards, knocking them prone or banging them against a wall.

force_powers.name: Injure/Kill
force_powers.warning: A character who uses this power receives a Dark Side Point.
force_powers.effect_summary: An attacker must be touching the target to use this power.

force_powers.name: Kinetic Combat
force_powers.effect_summary: Once the Jedi has successfully activated this power, he may wield a melee weapon or lightsaber with the power of the Force at a distance up to 10 meters, as though the weapon were in his hands using his melee weapons or lightsaber skill respectively.

force_powers.name: Telekinesis
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Very Easy for objects weighing one kilogram or less; Easy for objects weighing one to ten kilograms; Moderate for objects 11 to 100 kilograms; Difficult for 101 kilograms to one metric ton; Very Difficult for 1,001 kilograms to ten metric tons; Heroic for objects weighing 10,001 kilograms to 100 metric tons.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows the Jedi to levitate and move objects with the power of her mind alone.

force_powers.name: Farseeing
force_powers.control_difficulty: Very Easy, modified by proximity. Add +5 to +20 to the difficulty if the character wishes to see something in the past. Add +10 to +30 for the future.
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Very Easy if the target is friendly and doesn’t resist. If the target resists, make a control or Perception total for the difficulty. Modified by relationship.
force_powers.effect_summary: The Jedi may see the person or place he wishes to see in his mind as the situation currently exists.

force_powers.name: Life Bond
force_powers.effect_summary: A Jedi character may choose the life bond power to permanently form a mental link with one other individual, normally a mate (although sometimes siblings, parent and child, or even very close friends choose to life bond).

force_powers.name: Lifemerge
force_powers.effect_summary: A Jedi may attempt to activate this power at his death.

force_powers.name: Lightsaber Combat
force_powers.effect_summary: Jedi use this power to wield this elegant but difficult- to-control weapon while also sensing their opponents’ actions through the Force.

force_powers.name: Projective Telepathy
force_powers.control_difficulty: Very Easy. Increase difficulty by +5 to +10 if the Jedi cannot verbalize the thoughts she is transmitting (she is gagged or doesn’t want to make a sound). Modified by proximity.
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Very Easy if target is friendly and doesn’t resist. If target resists, roll Perception or control to determine the difficulty. Modified by relationship.
force_powers.effect_summary: If the Jedi successfully projects her thoughts, the target “hears” her thoughts and “feels” her emotions.

force_powers.name: Accelerate Another’s Healing
force_powers.effect_summary: The target is allowed to make extra healing rolls, as outlined in accelerate healing.

force_powers.name: Control Another’s Disease
force_powers.control_difficulty: Very Easy, as modified by relationship.
force_powers.time_to_use: 30 minutes to several uses over the course of several weeks.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows a Jedi to heal another character, using the same rules and conditions as outlined in control disease.

force_powers.name: Control Another’s Pain
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Easy for wounded characters; Moderate for incapacitated characters; Difficult for mortally wounded characters.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows a Jedi to help another character control pain, under the same rules and conditions outlined in the control pain power.

force_powers.name: Control Breathing
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows a Jedi to control the amount of oxygen flowing into his or her body.

force_powers.name: Detoxify Another’s Poison
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Very Easy for a very mild poison (such as alcohol); Easy for a mild poison; Moderate for an average poison; Difficult for a virulent poison; Very Difficult to Heroic for a neurotoxin.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows a Jedi to remove or detoxify poison from a patent’s body faster than is normally possible.

force_powers.name: Feed on Dark Side
force_powers.control_difficulty: Moderate when activated, Very Easy each round thereafter.
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Moderate when activated; no rolls required for subsequent rounds.
force_powers.warning: Any Jedi who activates this power automatically receives a Dark Side Point.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows a Jedi to feed on the fear, hatred, or other negative emotions of others to make himself more powerful.

force_powers.name: Force Jump
force_powers.effect_summary: A Jedi uses this power to increase his jumping ability in order to perform impossibly high leaps.

force_powers.name: Force Lightning
force_powers.control_difficulty: Difficult, modified by proximity, limited to line of sight.
force_powers.warning: A Jedi who uses this power for any reason immediately gains a Dark Side Point.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power is a corruption of the Force.

force_powers.name: Inflict Pain
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Target’s control or Perception. Modified by proximity.
force_powers.warning: A character who uses this power immediately receives a Dark Side Point.
force_powers.effect_summary: The target experiences great agony.

force_powers.name: Place Another in Hibernation Trance
force_powers.control_difficulty: Very Easy. Modified by the target’s relationship.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows a Jedi to put another character into a hibernation trance.

force_powers.name: Redirect Energy
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Very Difficult or target’s dodge roll.
force_powers.effect_summary: If the Jedi is the target of a Force energy attack (such as force lightning) he may attempt to send the energy back at the attacker.

force_powers.name: Remove Another’s Fatigue
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows the Jedi to remove the effects of effects of fatigue in another.

force_powers.name: Return Another to Consciousness
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Easy for incapacitated characters; Difficult for mortally wounded characters.
force_powers.effect_summary: The target returns to consciousness.

force_powers.name: Transfer Force
force_powers.effect_summary: This power will save a mortally wounded character from dying because the Jedi is transferring her life force to the target.

force_powers.name: Dim Another’s Senses
force_powers.effect_summary: This power greatly reduces the Perception of the target character.

force_powers.name: Greater Force Shield
force_powers.effect_summary: When a Jedi successfully activates this power, he creates a protective shield around his body.

force_powers.name: Lesser Force Shield
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows the Jedi to surround his body with a Force-generated shield.

force_powers.name: Affect Mind
force_powers.control_difficulty: Very Easy for perceptions; Easy for memories; Moderate for conclusions. Modified by proximity.
force_powers.sense_difficulty: The target’s control or Perception roll.
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Very Easy for slight, momentary misperceptions, minor changes to distant memories, or if the character doesn’t care one way or another. Easy for brief, visible phenomena, for memories less than a year old, or if the character feels only minor emotion regarding the conclusion he is reaching. Moderate for short hallucinations, for memories less than a day old, or if the target has strict orders about the conclusion. Difficult for slight disguises to facial features, hallucinations which can be sensed with two senses (sight and sound, for example), for memories less than a minute old, or if the matter involving the conclusion is very important to the target. Very Difficult for hallucinations which can be sensed by all five senses, if the memory change is major, or if the logic is clear and coming to the wrong conclusion is virtually impossible.
force_powers.effect_summary: The target character’s perceptions are altered so that he senses an illusion or fails to see what the user of the power doesn’t want him to see.

force_powers.name: Battle Meditation
force_powers.control_difficulty: Varies based on the number of targeted individuals. See table below:
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Varies based on the number of targeted individuals. See table below:
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Varies based on the number of targeted individuals. See table below:
force_powers.effect_summary: Battle meditation has two possible effects.

force_powers.name: Control Mind
force_powers.control_difficulty: Moderate, as modified by relationship. Targets with an affinity for the Force (i.e., have Force skill or Force Points) may make an opposed control or Perception rolls, selecting either their roll or the base difficulty to resist.
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Easy for a Jedi who has turned to the dark side, as modified by proximity. Moderate for a Jedi who is of the light side, as modified by proximity.
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Variable, depending on the number of targets being controlled and whether or not they are willing. Force-sensitive targets may make opposed rolls, choosing either their roll or the difficulty, whichever is higher.
force_powers.warning: Any Jedi who uses this power automatically receives a Dark Side Point, plus an additional Dark Side Point for every evil action she forces a victim of this power to undertake.
force_powers.note: The difficulties of this power are significantly decreased for those who have fallen to the dark side.
force_powers.effect_summary: The use of this power allows a Jedi to take control of another person turning him into a puppet who must obey the Jedi’s will.

force_powers.name: Create Force Storms
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Heroic modified by proximity. Modified by diameter of storm desired: +5 for 100 meters or less; +10 for 100 meters to 1 kilometer; +15 for a base of 1 kilometer and +2 for every additional kilometer. Modified by damage: +5 per 1D of damage. The user must make Heroic rolls each successive round to control the storm. She must also make a Very Difficult roll to dissipate the storm.
force_powers.warning: Force Storms are immensely destructive and violate the laws of nature. A Jedi using this power automatically receives a Dark Side Point.
force_powers.effect_summary: This is one of the most destructive Force powers known.

force_powers.name: Doppleganger
force_powers.warning: A character using this power receives a Dark Side Point.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power creates a doppelganger of the Force-user.

force_powers.name: Drain Life Essence
force_powers.control_difficulty: Very Difficult, inversely modified by relationship. For example, a close relative would add +30 to difficulty, while a total stranger of an alien species would add nothing.
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Easy for willing, worshipful subjects. Difficult for ambivalent or apathetic individuals. Heroic for enemies. Add +10 to the difficulty if individuals are imbued with the light side of the Force.
force_powers.warning: Any Jedi who uses this power gains a Dark Side Point.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows a Jedi to draw life energy from those around him and channel the negative effects of the dark side into those victims.

force_powers.name: Enhanced Coordination
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Dependent upon the number of people affected by the power.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows the Jedi to coordinate a group at the subconscious level to perform certain tasks more efficiently.

force_powers.name: Force Harmony
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows several willing Jedi to manifest the power of the light side.

force_powers.name: Projected Fighting
force_powers.effect_summary: Projected fighting allows the user to strike at an opponent, inflicting damage without physically touching the target.

force_powers.name: Telekinetic Kill
force_powers.warning: A character who uses this power automatically receives a Dark Side Point.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power is used to telekinetically injure or kill a target.

force_powers.name: Transfer Life
force_powers.control_difficulty: Heroic, modified by relationship. If the victim is unwilling, increase the difficulty by +15.
force_powers.sense_difficulty: Heroic, modified by proximity. If the target is unwilling, increase the difficulty by +15.
force_powers.alter_difficulty: Variable, depending on willingness and Force affinity.
force_powers.warning: Any Jedi using this power receives two Dark Side Points. If attempting to possess an unwilling host, the Jedi receives four Dark Side Points.
force_powers.effect_summary: This power allows character to transfer his or her life energy into another body.

force_powers.name: Force Scream
force_powers.note: This is an involuntary power that may be activated when a Dark Jedi loses control of her temper.
force_powers.effect_summary: The dark side of the Force is seductive, offering tremendous power to lure the weak-willed into its grip.

species.name: Humans
species.homeworlds: Various, including Coruscant, Corellia, Naboo, Tatooine, and Alderaan.
species.languages: Humans speak, read, and write Basic. They often learn other languages as well, including obscure ones.

stat_blocks.attribute_dice: Add 2D to the stats below, without adding more than 2 pips to any single attribute.
special_abilities: Military Training: All clones go through intensive military training throughout their formative years. At character creation only, clone characters receive an extra 2D to spend on military-related skills.
story_factors: Obedient: Clones are conditioned to obey their superior’s orders without question, loyally following the chain of command.
Accelerated Growth: Clones age twice as fast as normal humans.

species.name: Anzat
species.homeworlds: Anzati are native to Anzat, a mountainous world located in the Mid Rim.
species.languages: Anzati speak Anzat, an ancient language known only to them.

special_abilities: Anzati Tracking: Anzati are able to sense the Force in others, and each is automatically considered Force-sensitive and possessing of the Sense Force skill. When tracking prey, Anzati oftentimes use Force powers such as Life Detection, Life Sense, Receptive Telepathy, Sense Force, and Sense Force Potential.
Long-lived: Anzati are practically immortal, and can live for eons.
Stealthy: Because they must secretly hunt sentient beings, Anzati have grown adept at maintaining their stealth and secrecy. This is reflected in a +1D bonus to their hide and sneak skills.

Vampires: The Anzati feed from living beings: for every turn spent feeding, 2 pips are subtracted from the victim’s Knowledge, Mechanical, Perception, and Technical attributes. If any one attribute is reduced to 0 or less, the victim dies. The damage to the attributes is permanent, and reduces skills accordingly.

species.name: Aqualish
species.homeworlds: Aqualish are native to Ando, a mountainous world located in the Mid Rim. The planet’s sky is covered in an aurora that has deep religious significance for the Anzati.
species.languages: All three Aqualish subspecies speak mutually intelligible dialects of the same language, Aqualish.

special_abilities: Fins: Aqualish are born with the natural ability to swim. They receive a +2D bonus for all movement attempted in liquids. However, the lack of fingers on their hands decreases their Dexterity, and the Aqualish suffer a −2D penalty when using equipment that has not been specially designed for its fins.

Hands: The Quara and Ualaq do not receive the swimming bonus, but they are just as “at home” in the water. They also receive no penalties for Dexterity actions. The Ualaq are most likely to be encountered off-world.
story_factors: Belligerence: Aqualish tend to be pushy and obnoxious, always looking for the opportunity to bully weaker beings. More intelligent Aqualish turn this belligerence into cunning and become manipulators.

species.name: Barabel
species.homeworlds: Barab I.
species.languages: Barabel and those who have spent time off-world are likely to speak Basic.

special_abilities: Natural Body Armor: The black scales of the Barabel act as armor, providing a +2D bonus against physical attacks, and a +1D bonus against energy attacks.

Radiation Resistance: Because of the proximity of their homeworld to its sun, the Barabel have evolved a natural resistance to most forms of radiation. They receive a +2D bonus when defending against the effects of radiation.
Vision: Barabels can see infrared radiation, giving them the ability to see in compete darkness, provided there are heat differentials in the environment.
story_factors: Jedi Respect: Barabels have a deep respect for Jedi Knights, even though they have little aptitude for sensing the Force. They will almost always yield to the commands of a Jedi Knight (or a being that represents itself believably as a Jedi). Naturally, they are enemies of the enemies of Jedi (or those who impersonate Jedi).
Reputation: Barabels are reputed to be fierce warriors and great hunters, and they are often feared. Those who know of them almost always steer clear of them.

species.name: Bith
species.homeworlds: Bith originate from Clak’dor VII, a small planet in the Outer Rim that suffered heavily from the effects of biological warfare during a brief civil conflict. The inhabitants now reside in domed cities and rarely venture out of them onto the surface of the planet.
species.languages: Bith speak and read Bith. Those who leave the confines of their cities learn Basic as well.

special_abilities: Vision: Bith have the ability to focus on microscopic objects, giving them a +1D to Perception skills involving objects less than 30 centimeters away. However, as a consequence of this, the Bith have become extremely myopic. The suffer a penalty of −1D for any visual-based action more than 20 meters away and cannot see more than 40 meters under any circumstances.
Scent: Bith have well-developed senses of smell, giving them +1D to Perception skills when pertaining to actions and people within three meters.

Manual Dexterity: Although the Bith have low overall Dexterity scores, they do gain +1D to the performance of fine motor skills — picking pockets, surgery, fine tool operation, etc. — but not to gross motor skills such as blaster and dodge.

species.name: Bothan
species.homeworlds: The industrial world of Bothawui, with various colony worlds throughout the Mid Rim Territories.
species.languages: Bothans speak, read, and write Bothese and Basic.

species.name: Caamasi
species.homeworlds: The Core World of Caamas, prior to its devastation. The few survivors, along with Caamasi who were off-world at the time, migrated to Kerilt in the Algara system and also
species.languages: Caamasi speak, read, and write Caamasi and Basic.

special_abilities: Memory Sharing: Caamasi can store and share memories with others of their species. Force-users can also share memories with Caamasi, though this requires a successful use of either receptive telepathy (to receive a memory) or projective telepathy (to share a memory).
Wise and Tranquil: Due to their reputation for being peaceful and wise, Caamasi gain a +2 pip bonus to all bargain and persuasion rolls.

species.name: Cathar
species.homeworlds: Prior to the Battle of Cathar, most hail from their Cathar itself. After the battle, Cathar find refuge on most any Republic world.
species.languages: Cathar speak Catharese and Basic, using low growls and similar sounds to emphasize their point.

special_abilities: Claws: Cathar have claws that do STR+1D damage.

species.name: Cereans
species.homeworlds: The blissful planet Cerea.
species.languages: Cereans speak, read, and write Cerean & Basic.

special_abilities: Initiative Bonus: Due to outstanding cognitive speed, Cereans gain a +1D bonus to all initiative rolls.

Dual Hearts: Cereans can function with only one of these hearts, but the demands placed on their circulatory system by their binary brains are no laughing matter. A Cerean reduced to functioning on only one heart must sleep 2/3 of a given day to maintain his mental performance.

species.name: Chadra-Fan
species.homeworlds: The Chadra-Fan are native to Chad, a world located in the region of the Outer Rim known as the Slice. Covered with extensive marshes and bayous, the planet has nine moons, which give the world a complex tidal cycle.
species.languages: The Chadra-Fan language sounds substantially different from Basic, so those Chadra-Fan who speak Basic do so with a very squeaky tone.

special_abilities: Sight: The Chadra-Fan have the ability to see in the infrared and ultraviolet ranges, allowing them to see in all conditions short of absolute darkness.
Smell: The Chadra-Fan have extremely sensitive smelling which gives them a +2D bonus to their search skill.
story_factors: Tinkerers: Any mechanical device left within reach of a Chadra-Fan has the potential to be disassembled and then reconstructed. However, it is not likely that the reconstructed device will have the same function as the original. Most droids will develop a pathological fear of Chadra-Fan.

species.name: Chiss
species.homeworlds: The frigid world of Csilla, in the Unknown Regions.
species.languages: Cheunh is the complex and nuance-laden language of the Chiss. Most non-Chiss have difficulty learning the intricacies of Cheunh. Chiss, on the other hand, have little difficulty mastering Basic, but most of them are unfamiliar with it.

special_abilities: Low Light Vision: Chiss can see twice as far as a normal human in poor lighting conditions. The gamemaster should allow Chiss characters to make the appropriate Perception-based skill checks at a lower difficulty than normal human characters.
Skill Bonuses: At the time of character creation only, Chiss characters gain 2D for every one die they assign to the tactics, command, and scholar: art skills.
Tactics: Chiss characters receive a permanent +1D bonus to all tactics skill rolls.

species.name: Defel
species.homeworlds: Defel come from the planet Af’EI, which orbits the super-giant Ka’Dedus in the Outer Rim. The world receives few visitors because of its high gravity and its unusual atmosphere that blocks all but ultraviolet light.
species.languages: Defel speak and read Defel. Adventurous Defel that leave the homeworld learn Basic.

special_skills: Blind Fighting: Time to use: one round. Defel can use this skill instead of their brawling or melee combat skills when deprived of their sight visors or otherwise rendered blind. Blind fighting teaches the Defel to use its senses of smell and hearing to overcome any blindness penalties.
special_abilities: Invisibility: Defel receive a +3D bonus when using the sneak skill. Claws: The claws of the Defel can inflict STR+2D damage.

Light Blind: Defel eyes can only detect ultraviolet light, and the presence of any other light effectively blinds the Defel. Defel can wear special sight visors which block out all other light waves, allowing them to see, but if a Defel loses its visor, the difficulty of any task involving sight is increased by one level.
story_factors: Reputation: Defel are considered to be a myth by most of the galaxy — therefore, when they are encountered, they are often thought to be supernatural beings. Most Defel in the galaxy enjoy taking advantage of this perception.

Overconfidence: Most Defel are comfortable knowing that, if they wish to hide, no one will be able to spot them. They often ignore surveillance equipment and characters who might have special perception abilities when they should not.

species.name: Devaronian
species.homeworlds: Devaron, a world of low mountains and deep valleys linked by thousands of rivers.
species.languages: Devaronians speak and read Devaronese and Basic. Their speech is guttural, and full of snarling consonants.

story_factors: Wanderlust: Devaronian males do not like to stay in one place for any extended period of time. Usually, the first opportunity that they get to move on, they take.

species.name: Dug
species.homeworlds: Malastare.
species.languages: Dug and sometimes Basic.

special_abilities: Climbing/Jumping Bonus: Due to their physiology, Dugs gain a +1D bonus to their climbing/jumping skill.
Shout: Dugs can issue forth a deep bellow which can be heard up to 3 kilometers away.
story_factors: Reputation: Dugs are known as bullies and thugs by most other sentient species’, and are almost universally disliked by non-Dugs. Many crimelords, however, employ them as assassins and henchmen.

species.name: Duros
species.homeworlds: The orbiting cities of the Duro system.
species.languages: Duros speak and are literate in Durese and Basic.

special_abilities: Starship Intuition: Duros are, by their nature, extremely skilled starship pilots and navigators. When a Duros character is generated, 1D (no more) may be placed in the following skills, for which the character receives 2D of ability: archaic starship piloting, astrogation, capital ship gunnery, capital ship shields, sensors, space transports, starfighter piloting, starship gunnery, and starship shields. This bonus also applies to any specializations. If the character wishes to have more than 2D in the skill listed, then the skill costs are normal from there on.

species.name: Ewok
species.homeworlds: The forest moon of Endor.
species.languages: Ewoks speak Ewokese. They have no written form of their language. They can learn to speak Basic.

special_skills: Thrown weapons: bow, rocks, sling, spear: Time to use: one round. The character may take the base skill and/or any of the specializations.
Glider: Time to use: one round. The ability to pilot gliders.

Primitive construction: Time to use: one hour for gliders and rope bridges; several hours for small structures, catapults and similar constructs. This is the ability to build structures out of wood, vines and other natural materials with only primitive tools. This skill is good for building study houses, vine bridges and rock-hurling catapults (2D, speeder-scale damage).
special_abilities: Skill bonus: At the time the character is created only, the character gets 2D for every 1D placed in the hide, search and sneak skills. Skill limits: Beginning characters may not place any skill dice in any vehicle (other than glider) or starship operations or repair skills. Smell: Ewoks have a highly developed sense of smell, getting a +1D to their search skill when tracking by scent. This ability may not be improved.
story_factors: Protectiveness: Most human adults will feel unusually protective of Ewoks, wanting to defend them like young children. Because of this, humans can also be very condescending to Ewoks. Ewoks, however, are mature and inquisitive — and unusually tolerant of the human attitude.

species.name: Falleen
species.homeworlds: The Falleen hail from a world of the same name in the Mid Rim.
species.languages: Base and Falleen.

special_abilities: Attraction Pheromones: Exuding special pheromones and changing skin color to affect others gives Falleen a +1D to their persuasion skill, with an additional +1D for each hour of continuous preparation and meditation to enhance efforts — the bonus may total no more than +3D for any one skill attempt, and the attempt must be made within one hour of completing meditation.
Amphibious: Falleen can “breathe” water for up to 12 hours. They receive a +1D to any swimming skill rolls.
story_factors: Rare: Falleen are rarely seen throughout the galaxy since the Imperial blockade in their system severely limited travel to and from their homeworld.

species.name: Gamorrean
species.homeworlds: The pre-industrial world of Gamorr.
species.languages: Gamorreans speak Gamorrean. They have no written version of the language. They can learn to understand but not speak other languages.

special_abilities: Voice Box: Due to their unusual voice apparatus, Gamorreans are unable to pronounce Basic, although they can understand it perfectly well.
Stamina: Gamorreans have great stamina — whenever asked to make a stamina check, if they fail the first check, they may immediately make a second check to succeed.
Skill Bonus: At the time the character is created only, the character gets 2D for every 1D placed in the melee weapons, brawling and thrown weapons skills.
story_factors: Droid Hate: Most Gamorreans hate droids and other mechanical beings. During each scene in which a Gamorrean player character needlessly demolishes a droid (provided the gamemaster and other players consider the scene amusing), the character should receive an extra Character Point.

Reputation: Gamorreans are widely regarded as primitive, brutal and mindless. Gamorreans who attempt to show intelligent thought and manners will often be disregarded and ridiculed by fellow Gamorreans.
Slavery: Most Gamorreans who left Gamorr did so by being sold into slavery by their clans.

species.name: Gand
species.homeworlds: Gand come come from the poisonous world of Gand.
species.languages: Geed lack the organs to speak any language other than Gand and, therefore, rely on transliterators to communicate in other tongues.

special_abilities: Ammonia Breathers: Most Gand do not respire. However, there is a small number of Gand that are of older evolutionary stock and do respire in the traditional sense. These Gand are ammonia breathers and find other gases toxic to their respiratory system — including oxygen.

Exoskeleton: The ceremonial chemical baths of some findsmen initiations promote the growth of pronounced knobby bits on a Gand’s exoskeleton. The bits on a Gand’s arms or legs can be used as rough, serrated weapons in close-quarter combat and will do STR+1 damage when brawling.

Eye Shielding: Most Gand have a double layer of eye shielding. The first layer is composed of a transparent keratin-like substance: the Gand suffers no adverse effects from sandstorms or conditions with other airborne debris. The Gand’s second layer of eye protection is an exceptionally durable chitin that can endure substantial punishment. For calculating damage, this outer layer has the same Strength as the character.
Findsman Ceremonies: Gand use elaborate and arcane rituals to find
prey. Whenever a Gand uses a ritual (which takes at least three hours) he gains a +2D to track a target.
Mist Vision: Having evolved on a mist-enshrouded world, Gand receive a +2D advantage to Perception and relevant skills in environments obscured by smoke, fog, or other gases.

Natural Armor: Gand have limited clavicle armor about their shoulders and neck, which provides +2 physical protection to that region (they are immune to nerve or pressure point strikes to the neck or shoulders.)

Regeneration: Many Gand — particularly those who have remained on their homeworld or are of one of the very traditional sects — can regenerate lost limbs. Once a day, a Gand must make a Strength or stamina roll: a Very Difficult roll results in 20 percent regeneration; a Difficult roll will result in 10 percent regeneration, a Moderate roll will not assist a Gand’s accelerated healing process, and the character must wait until the next day to roll. Reserve Sleep: Most Gand need only a fraction of the sleep most living beings require. They can “store” sleep for times when being unconscious is not desirable. As such, the Gand need not make
stamina rolls with the same frequency as most characters for purposes of determining the effects of sleep-deprivation. Unless otherwise stated, this is an assumed trait in a Gand.
Ultraviolet Vision: Gand can see in the ultraviolet color spectrum.
story_factors: Martial Arts: Some Gand are trained in a specialized form of combat

developed by a band of findsman centuries ago. The tenets of the art are complex and misunderstood, but the few that have been described. Two techniques are described below. There are believed to be many more.
“Piercing Touch” Description: The findsman can use his chitinous fist

to puncture highly durable substances and materials. Difficulty: Very Difficult Effect: If the character rolls successfully (and is not parried or dodged), the strike does STR+2D damage and can penetrate bone, chitin, and assorted armors.
“Striking Mist” Description: The findsman can sneak close enough to

an opponent to prevent the victim from dodging or parrying the blow. Difficulty: Difficult Effect: If the character rolls successfully, and rolls a successful sneak versus his opponent’s Perception, the findsman’s strike cannot be dodged or parried. The Gand must declare whether they are striking to injure or immobilize the victim prior to making the attempt.

species.name: Geonosian
species.homeworlds: The world of Geonosis.
species.languages: Geonosians speak Geonosian, a strange clicking language. Aristocrat Geonosians often understand Basic Fluently, some even speak it.

special_abilities: Flight: Geonosian aristocrats have wings, and are able to fly.
Natural Armor: Due to their thick chitinous shells, Geonosian aristocrats gain a +2 pip bonus to Strength rolls made to resist any form of damage.
Radiation Resistance: Geonosians gain a +2 pip bonus to Strength rolls made to resist the effects of harmful radiation.
story_factors: Caste-Driven Society: Geonosians are born into a caste-dominated society. Any Geonosian worker who wishes to leave the toils of his caste may do so by participating in gladiatorial combat, but at the very real risk of death. Geonosian aristocrats hold the power within their society, while the workers are considered more or less expendable.

species.name: Givin
species.homeworlds: Givin are from the planet Yag’Duhl, located in the Inner Rim. Massive tidal forces constantly tug at the water and atmosphere of the planet, exposing areas to hard vacuum. The Givin reside inside sealed cities that are able to withstand the massive crush of tidal energy.
species.languages: The Givin language is thick with mathematical terms, and the written language conveys information using hundreds of mathematical symbols. Individuals without a grounding in advanced mathematics find the species’ language almost incomprehensible.
